scopedCoverageNotes.text: Selected actual official New York County sample ballots verify nine local candidate fields: Surrogate, Supreme Court District1, county Civil Court, Council District3 and municipal Civil Court districts1/3/4/7/9. Five held contest identities and their18 held candidacy identities are reused; four municipal district offices and eight printed choices are new.

The current-linked BOE New York county inventory enumerates these nine local fields. No other mayoral, borough president, prosecutor, school or special district candidate field appears in that inventory. Selected samples cover every enumerated local field; every remaining PDF style has not been compared for late changes.

Blank Write-in cells are not people. Separate declared write-in certification remains acquisition work. Five held citywide charter proposals and all their explanations remain unchanged outside this candidate packet. Exact judicial and Council district reader membership joins remain the registry owner’s work.
